language.label: Language

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add Boda Kilgoris to your home screen. It opens faster and works better on slow networks.

welcome.intro: Choose how you want to use the app.
welcome.paymentNote: Payment is in cash between you and the Boda. Nothing is paid in the app.

geo.consentBodyBoda: While you are set as available, the app sends your position every 10 to 15 seconds so clients can see you on the map and choose you. When you are not available, nothing is sent. During a ride, the client who accepted you can follow you.
geo.consentBodyClient: The app uses your position to show the Bodas near you and to set your pick-up point. Your position is only shared with the Boda you choose, and only when you request a ride. You can also place the pick-up pin by hand on the map.
geo.denied: Location is blocked. Turn it on in your browser settings, then try again.
geo.unavailable: We could not find your location. Move to an open place and try again.
geo.timeout: Finding your location takes too long. Try again.
geo.unsupported: This phone or browser cannot give a location.
geo.consentGiven: You agreed to share your location.
geo.consentNone: You have not agreed to share your location yet.

auth.photoHint: A clear photo of your face. Clients see it.
auth.noAccount: I do not have an account yet
auth.bodaRegisterTitle: Become a Boda on the app
auth.bodaRegisterIntro: The admin will check your account before you can receive rides.
auth.clientStartIntro: No password. Just your name and your phone number.
auth.pinMismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
auth.registered: Account created. It is waiting for approval.
auth.accountCreated: Your account is created ✓ You can add your photo now, or later from the home page.
auth.photoRestarted: The app restarted while the camera was open. Your account is safe. Please try the photo again.
auth.draftRestored: We kept what you typed. Please enter your PIN again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phaseNote: Phase 1: the app is free. Payment is in cash between you and the Boda.

overview.question: How many real rides go through the app?

rides.title: Rides
rides.limitReached: Only the latest {count} are shown. Narrow the dates or export the CSV.

map.title: Available Bodas
map.none: No Boda is available right now.

places.title: Frequent places
places.intro: Clients see these as quick buttons under the destination field. Add the real places of Kilgoris. Deactivating a place only hides it; past rides are not changed.
places.name: Name
places.coordsHint: Tap the map to set the position, or paste coordinates like -1.0035, 34.8767.
places.empty: No places yet. Add the first one above.

catalog.title: Article catalogue
catalog.intro: Clients tick articles from this list when they write a shopping list. Hiding an article only removes it from new lists: past orders keep the names they were made with.

shopping.title: Shopping orders
shopping.hint: Counted separately from rides, with the same rule: an order is counted when the Boda AND the client confirm (or after 30 minutes).
shopping.topCustomHint: Good candidates to add to the catalogue.
shopping.footer: No money goes through the app: the Boda advances it and the client repays on delivery.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.intro: Private to the admin. Orders are never blocked: an alert only tells you that a word from the list appeared in an order.
alerts.banner: {count, plural, one {# new alert} other {# new alerts}}
alerts.toastNew: {count, plural, one {New alert} other {# new alerts}}
alerts.recurrence: {n, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} {category} alert in 30 days
alerts.loadFailed: Could not load the alerts. Check the connection and try again.

settings.title: Alert settings
settings.intro: Choose which words raise a private alert. This never stops or changes an order.
settings.masterOn: On: matching orders create an alert.
settings.masterOff: Off: no alert is created at all.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the settings. Try again.
settings.testWould: This text WOULD raise an alert.
settings.testMatchOff: A word matches but its alert is switched off: no alert.
settings.testNone: No word from the list matches: no alert.
settings.alertOnLabel: Raise an alert for this word
settings.termsHint: Whole words only: "gin" matches "gin" but not "ginger". Switch a word off to stop its alerts.
settings.retentionHint: Handled or ignored alerts older than this are deleted. Old open alerts lose their text and note. Counters are kept.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.notice: The app team can view the content of orders, in particular for safety, to follow the service, and to offer you support if you wish.
privacy.more: Your phone number and your orders are never shared with other people or companies.
